regions.region: title and graphical abstract in the upper and middle page
regions.finding: The generic Rh(I)-catalyzed allene-to-diene transformation, two alternative catalyst systems, 120 °C, maximum 92% yield, and E/Z claim were captured as a general scheme rather than an individual batch experiment.

regions.region: abstract and introduction below the graphical abstract
regions.finding: Contains scope claims and background/prior-art discussion; no additional experiment specific enough to duplicate as a current-paper batch was found on this page.

unresolved: The graphical abstract uses generic R groups and does not identify which catalyst alternative applies to an individual substrate.
No SI file was explicitly associated.

regions.finding: Three cited prior-work transformations were retained as literature examples with their visible yields/product ratios; they were not classified as experiments newly reported by this paper.
The Rh coordination/oxametalation/beta-elimination cycle and favored trans-4 rationale were captured as a proposed mechanism, without assigning an experimental yield to intermediates.

The prose corroborates Table 1 entries 1-11, including the two no-reaction cases, catalyst-loading changes, and ligand additives; the independent row records are anchored primarily to the full table on page 3 and cross-linked here rather than duplicated.
Discussion of earlier transition-metal rearrangements and references is contextual prior art; no further current-paper experiment was created.

unresolved: Scheme 1 uses generic R groups and omits most operating conditions.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed and not structure-verified.

regions.finding: All eleven optimization rows were extracted independently, including NMR yields, E/Z ratios where present, recovered 1a, scale/volume overrides, PPh3 or PMe3 additives, and the 81% isolated yield footnote for entry 10.
All twelve substrate-scope rows were extracted independently under Conditions A or B, including times, isolated yields, E/Z ratios, and the 4 mmol/1 mol% catalyst override for entry 7.

The Rh values duplicate Table 2 entries 1, 6, and 11 and were not duplicated. The three Au columns explicitly marked protocol ref. 16 were retained as literature-example records, with yield, selectivity, and recovery kept distinct.
Heating the 59/41 E-2e/Z-2e mixture with 2 mol% Rh(CO)(PPh3)2Cl in toluene at 120 °C for 5 h was extracted separately, giving a final 64/36 ratio; no yield was reported.
Narrative scope and comparison statements were reconciled with Table 2 and Scheme 3 and were not converted into duplicate experiments.

unresolved: Table rows omit atmosphere, workup and purification.
Table 2 entry 7 does not make explicit whether the 6 mL solvent volume was scaled with the 4 mmol batch.
The Au comparison is classified as cited literature because the figure explicitly marks protocol ref. 16.

regions.finding: Three distinct scope experiments were extracted for p-nitrobenzoate 1k, carbonate 1l, and sterically hindered acetate 1m; catalyst/ligand loadings, time, temperature, yield, and reported E/Z values were preserved.
ORTEP drawing is characterization evidence for E-2k, not a separate reaction; it is linked to the Scheme 4 equation 5 record.
The 1n arrow and both condition rows for 1o were extracted as three experiments. Combined product yield, stereoisomer ratio, and starting-material recovery remain separate outcomes.

The hydrolysis, NIS iodination, and DMAD Diels-Alder arrows from E-2e were extracted as three independent experiments, including all explicit equivalents, catalyst/additive loading, solvents, temperatures, times, and yields.

regions.region: lower-page prose, summary, acknowledgments, SI notice and references
regions.finding: Prose corroborates Scheme 5 and 6 products and yields. The SI notice states availability but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated, so no SI-only details were imported.

unresolved: Most schemes omit reaction scale, solvent volume, yield measurement basis, atmosphere, workup and purification.
Several depicted structures and all stereochemical assignments remain machine-unverified.
Supporting Information was mentioned but not explicitly provided/associated.
